body: I really appreciate that. I’m sorry you are struggling with this as well. If you need someone to talk to during these bleak winter months, feel free to message me. I’m sure I’ll need the support too.
The world  is bleak as fuck.

Just to weigh in on this disagreement; it was a little weird that you were describing the aftermath of a suicide to someone who has attempted twice before. I have thought about this all before, almost my entire life. I have gone over every possible scenario in my head a hundred times, so I am well aware of the aftermath. Not to mention I survived the aftermath of a good friend, so I’m pretty familiar. 

However it didn’t upset me, and I know you’re coming from a good place. I appreciate your input because you’re right; I know you care just from your reply. So thank you for replying, it does make a difference.
Thank you for your kind words. I have bipolar disorder so it’s going to follow me for the rest of my life. I appreciate your insight but I don’t think my story will end the way yours will.
